title: Meet Best Buy Gamers: a new experience built for gamers
summary: Best Buy Gamers in beta is a new online destination that gives gaming fans a more personalized way to explore gaming content and more.
body_markdown:
By Best Buy


October 20, 2026


## Best Buy Gamers launches in beta; builds on Best Buy gaming experiences, bringing personalized content, member benefits and new experiences together in one destination


**Key Highlights**


- **Best Buy Gamers™** **:** Launching in beta


Oct. 20, Best Buy Gamers is a new online destination featuring gaming content, the latest tech, special offers, sweepstakes, experiences and more.


- **Content powered by IGN** **:** Best Buy partnered with IGN to bring gamers access to gaming news, trailers and more to stay up to date on the latest releases and trends.


- **In-store events:** Best Buy Gamers will feature Best Buy’s biggest gaming moments, including late-night openings and other in-store events.


Today Best Buy is launching


[Best Buy Gamers](https://www.bestbuy.com/gamers) in beta, a new online destination that gives gaming fans a more personalized way to explore gaming content, the latest tech and gear, special offers and sweepstakes, experiences and more. And as part of the launch, Best Buy and IGN are partnering to bring gamers content right to the experience.


Gaming is one of the biggest ways people experience technology, entertainment and culture. Millions of gamers shop with Best Buy each year, not just for the latest tech, but to try and experience it in stores and get expert advice and support. Best Buy Gamers builds on those relationships with a destination designed around how gamers play and what they care about most.


“For many, gaming isn’t just about playing. It’s the excitement of following new launches, discovering what’s next and being part of the moments that bring gamers together,” said Patrick McGinnis, chief revenue officer at Best Buy. “For decades, Best Buy has been the destination for gamers, and Best Buy Gamers is another way we’re reaching more customers and bringing fans closer to the culture they love, from the lead-up to launch day to the hours spent playing at home.”


The free digital experience is available on BestBuy.com and the Best Buy App starting Oct. 20. As gamers share feedback

## More ways to discover, play and connect


Best Buy Gamers is designed to make it easier for gamers to keep up with what’s next. Instead of searching across multiple places for news, reviews, preorders and deals, customers can find them in one experience that reflects their platforms and interests. Here’s what fans can expect from Best Buy Gamers starting Oct. 20:


- **Expert content from IGN** **:** Through its new partnership with IGN, gamers will find special gaming reviews, articles and videos, including content created just for Best Buy’s Gamers.


- **Personalized profiles:** Gamers can create a personal profile and select their favorite platforms and devices, the genres they follow and how they like to play.


- **In-store gaming experience:** This November, gamers will have the opportunity to experience Best Buy Gamers Beta live with the grand opening of a dedicated in-store gaming experience in Torrance, Calif. There, gamers can play the latest titles, get expert tips and attend events hosted in partnership with IGN.
- **Event updates:** Best Buy Gamers will feature Best Buy’s biggest gaming moments, including in-store events like the


[upcoming late-night store openings to celebrate the Nov. 5 launch of The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time](https://corporate.bestbuy.com/2026/zelda/) and a


[League of Legends pop-up with Alienware and Team Liquid](https://www.eventbrite.com/e/team-liquid-alienware-pop-up-at-best-buy-tickets-2003297297143?aff=oddtdtcreator) at the Best Buy store in Brooklyn.


- **Gear, deals and member offers:** Gamers can explore new gear to take their play to the next level, find deals on the hottest products and unlock exclusive offers for My Best Buy Plus™ and My Best Buy Total™ members.


## Score big with sweepstakes and offers


Best Buy Gamers isn’t just about following the action — it’s also about getting the chance to be part of it too. Through the experience, customers can enter special sweepstakes daily, including the chance to win an in-store speed run around a Best Buy.2 The sweepstakes run now through the end of November, and the winner will get two minutes to fill a shopping cart with products and take home all the items they grabbed.


To celebrate the launch, the first customers to create a profile will receive a $5 bonus reward.3
